summary: Split the board fix into an API filter and the board read.

root.title: Board shows every active ticket
root.objective: An active ticket appears in its lane however many newer tickets exist.
root.scope_boundaries: In: the board population read. Out: lane derivation.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An active ticket with 100 newer tickets appears in its lane.

children.title: Ticket list accepts several stages
children.objective: The ticket list filters by several stages at once.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A list request with two stages returns both.

children.title: Board reads its population by stage
children.objective: The board reads active tickets by stage instead of the newest 100.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The board requests active stages only.
